movies.overview: In 1941 Hawaii, a private is cruelly punished for not boxing on his unit's team, while his captain's wife and second in command are falling in love.
movies.title: From Here to Eternity
movies.tagline: The boldest book of our time… honestly, fearlessly on the screen!

movies.overview: A weary gunfighter attempts to settle down with a homestead family, but a smouldering settler and rancher conflict forces him to act.
movies.title: Shane
movies.tagline: The greatest story of the West ever filmed!

movies.overview: Drunk and disillusioned Roman, Marcellus Gallio, wins Jesus' robe in a dice game after the crucifixion. Marcellus has never been a man of faith like his slave, Demetrius, but when Demetrius escapes with the robe, Marcellus experiences disturbing visions and feels guilty for his actions. Convinced that destroying the robe will cure him, Marcellus sets out to find Demetrius — and discovers his Christian faith along the way.
movies.title: The Robe
movies.tagline: The first motion picture in CinemaScope--the modern miracle you see without glasses!

movies.overview: Overwhelmed by her suffocating schedule, touring European princess Ann takes off for a night while in Rome. When a sedative she took from her doctor kicks in, however, she falls asleep on a park bench and is found by an American reporter, Joe Bradley, who takes her back to his apartment for safety. At work the next morning, Joe finds out Ann's regal identity and bets his editor he can get exclusive interview with her, but romance soon gets in the way.
movies.title: Roman Holiday

movies.overview: Members of a circus troupe "adopt" Lili Daurier when she finds herself stranded in a strange town. The magician who first comes to her rescue already has romantic entanglements and thinks of her as a little girl. Who can she turn to but the puppets, singing to them her troubles, forgetting that there are puppeteers? A crowd gathers around Lili as she sings. The circus has a new act. She now has a job. Will she get her heart's desire?
movies.title: Lili
movies.tagline: You'll fall in love with...

movies.overview: After two American prisoners are killed by guards in the act of escaping from a German POW camp in World War II, barracks black marketeer J.J. Sefton is suspected of being an informer.
movies.title: Stalag 17
movies.tagline: The star-spangled, laugh-loaded salute to our P.W. heroes!

movies.overview: Two aging playboys are both after the same attractive young woman, but she fends them off by claiming that she plans to remain a virgin until her wedding night. Both men determine to find a way around her objections.
movies.title: The Moon Is Blue
movies.tagline: From the Sensational Stage Hit That Ran 3 years on Broadway!

movies.overview: A war correspondent who was stationed in Paris during WW II married a French girl who was murdered by the Nazis. After the war he returns to to try to find his son, whom he lost during a bombing raid but has been told is living in an orphanage in Paris.
movies.title: Little Boy Lost
movies.tagline: STRAIGHT FROM THE HEART

movies.overview: At the start of World War II, Cmdr. Ericson is assigned to convoy escort HMS Compass Rose with inexperienced officers and men just out of training. The winter seas make life miserable enough, but the men must also harden themselves to rescuing survivors of U-Boat attacks, while seldom able to strike back. Traumatic events afloat and ashore create a warm bond between the skipper and his first officer
movies.title: The Cruel Sea

movies.overview: Washington hostess Sally Adams becomes a Truman-era US ambassador to a European grand duchy.
movies.title: Call Me Madam

movies.overview: Army despatch rider Hondo Lane discovers a woman and her son living in the midst of warring Apaches, and he becomes their protector.
movies.title: Hondo
movies.tagline: Out of the gun smoke into her heart!

movies.overview: Mediterranean ferryboat captain Henry St James has things well organized - a loving and very English wife Maud in Gibraltar, and the loving if rather more hot-blooded Mistress, Nita in Tangiers. A perfect life. As long as neither woman decides to follow him to the other port.
movies.title: The Captain's Paradise
movies.tagline: He makes two-timing an art...and gets away with it

movies.overview: The owner of an impoverished circus in Communist-ruled Czechoslovokia plots to flee across the border to freedom, taking his entire troupe of performers and wild animals with him.
movies.title: Man on a Tightrope
movies.tagline: It's true! The stranger-than-fiction story that screams with SUSPENSE!

movies.overview: Three women set out to find eligible millionaires to marry, but find true love in the process.
movies.title: How to Marry a Millionaire
movies.tagline: The Most Glamorous Entertainment Of Your Lifetime in CinemaScope. You See It Without Glasses!

movies.overview: A pair of divorced actors are brought together to participate in a musical version of The Taming of the Shrew. Of course, the couple seem to act a great deal like the characters they play, and they must work together when mistaken identities get them mixed up with the mafia.
movies.title: Kiss Me Kate
movies.tagline: Famed Stage Hit Now Big Color Musical!

movies.overview: Unhappily married, Julia Sturges decides to go to America with her two children on the Titanic. Her husband, Richard also arranges passage on the luxury liner so as to have custody of their two children. All this fades to insignificance once the ship hits an iceberg.
movies.title: Titanic
movies.tagline: TITANIC in Emotion...in Spectacle...in Climax...in Cast!

movies.overview: A lavish documentary film of Queen Elizabeth II's Coronation in 1953.
movies.title: A Queen Is Crowned

movies.overview: On a Kenyan safari, white hunter Victor Marswell has a love triangle with seductive American socialite Eloise Kelly and anthropologist Donald Nordley's cheating wife Linda.
movies.title: Mogambo
movies.tagline: Flaming love found in the savage heart of the jungle!

movies.overview: The mother died under the executioner's axe; the daughter rose to become England's greatest monarch -- the brilliant and cunning Queen Elizabeth I. Jean Simmons portrays young Bess in this rich tapestry of a film that traces the tumultuous, danger-fraught years from Elizabeth's birth to her unexpected ascension to the throne at a mere 25. Charles Laughton reprises his Academy Award®-winning* role as her formidable father Henry VIII. Deborah Kerr plays her last stepmother (and Henry's last of six wives), gentle Catherine Parr. And Simmons' then real-life husband, Stewart Granger, adds heroics as Lord Admiral Thomas Seymour. In a resplendent world of adventure, romance and court intrigue, Young Bess reigns.
movies.title: Young Bess
movies.tagline: A Great and Spectacular Drama!

movies.overview: A girl of wealth comes to a Dutch community outside Chicago as a schoolteacher, and while there falls in love with a poor but big-hearted farmer.
movies.title: So Big
movies.tagline: How Big is a Big Picture?

movies.overview: The story of Colonel Paul Tibbets, the pilot that dropped the atomic bomb on Hiroshima. Although unaware of the full potential of this new weapon, he knows that it can do tremendously more damage than any other weapon used before, and that the death toll resulting from it will be huge. He is reluctant to be the person who will end so many lives, but as time goes on, the pressure upon him only increase.
movies.title: Above and Beyond
movies.tagline: The love story behind the billion dollar secret!

movies.overview: Lorelei Lee is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond, much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw, Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone, a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage.
movies.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
movies.tagline: The Two M-M-Marvels Of Our Age In The Wonder Musical Of The World!

movies.overview: The true story of Ruth Gordon's early struggles on the road to stage stardom.
movies.title: The Actress
movies.tagline: There's hope and heart-ache in the adventures of a stage-struck daughter!

movies.overview: Leaving the safety of their nursery behind, Wendy, Michael and John follow Peter Pan to a magical world where childhood lasts forever. But while in Neverland, the kids must face Captain Hook and foil his attempts to get rid of Peter for good.
movies.title: Peter Pan
movies.tagline: It will live in your heart forever!

movies.overview: A Broadway artiste turns a faded film star's comeback vehicle into an artsy flop.
movies.title: The Band Wagon
movies.tagline: Get Aboard!

movies.overview: Passengers on an ocean liner recall their greatest loves.
movies.title: The Story of Three Loves
movies.tagline: Dangerous Love. Jealous Love. Forbidden Love.

movies.overview: When a priest hears a murderer’s confession, he becomes bound by his vow of silence—even as circumstantial evidence turns suspicion toward him. Torn between faith and self-preservation, he faces public scandal and trial for a crime he cannot reveal the truth about.
movies.title: I Confess
movies.tagline: If you knew what he knew what would you do?

movies.overview: The growing ambition of Julius Caesar is a source of major concern to his close friend Brutus. Cassius persuades him to participate in his plot to assassinate Caesar but both have sorely underestimated Mark Antony.
movies.title: Julius Caesar
movies.tagline: MGM's acclaimed production of William Shakespeare's Julius Caesar.

movies.overview: The residents of a small town are excited when a flaming meteor lands in the hills, until they discover it is the first of many transport devices from Mars bringing an army of invaders invincible to any man-made weapon, even the atomic bomb.
movies.title: The War of the Worlds
movies.tagline: Mighty panorama of Earth-shaking fury as an army from Mars invades!

movies.overview: Irwin Allen explores the mysteries of the deep blue sea in this Technicolor documentary. Based on Rachel L. Carson's famous study, this Oscar winning project investigates everything under the sea, from sharks, whales and octopuses to microscopical creatures and their coexistence in this vast underwater world.
movies.title: The Sea Around Us
movies.tagline: A Thrilling World of Wonders You've Never Seen Before!

movies.overview: In Camelot, kingdom of Arthur and Merlin, Lancelot is well known for his courage and honor. But one day he must quit Camelot and the Queen Guinevere's love, leaving the Round Table without protection.
movies.title: Knights of the Round Table
movies.tagline: All the glory and splendor of King Arthur's court

movies.overview: Sharpshooter Calamity Jane takes it upon herself to recruit a famous actress and bring her back to the local saloon, but jealousy soon gets in the way.
movies.title: Calamity Jane
movies.tagline: Warner Bros.' sky highest, smile widest, wild and woolliest Western of 'em all!

movies.overview: Short about the daily life of the Apaches, including their ceremonies.
movies.title: Apache

movies.overview: A sculptor opens a wax museum to showcase the likenesses of famous historical figures, but quickly runs into trouble when his business partner demands the exhibits become more extreme in order to increase profits.
movies.title: House of Wax
movies.tagline: You've never been scared until you've been scared in 3-D.

movies.original_title: The Story of Gilbert and Sullivan
movies.overview: The career of W. S. Gilbert, a barrister turned comic librettist, and Arthur Sullivan, a composer turned against his will to light music, who together wrote fifteen comic operas between 1871 and 1896, to great public acclaim.
movies.title: The Story of Gilbert and Sullivan
